budgets.title: A Celebration for every price point.
budgets.body: यह total hamper budget है, सिर्फ empty box की कीमत नहीं. Final mix budget, size, availability और presentation के हिसाब से curate होगा.

products.title: Pick the feeling, not just the products.
products.body: हर item की availability budget tier के हिसाब से controlled है. Locked items साफ दिखेंगे कि वे किस hamper से available हैं.

builder.title: Build your Celebration in 4 simple steps.
builder.body: Budget rules automatically protect the order mix—आप सिर्फ वही products चुन पाएँगे जो selected hamper में fit होते हैं.

budget.title: 1. Pick a hamper budget
budget.body: Your budget decides product eligibility, quantity, packaging and finishing.

products.title: 2. Tell us what they'll love
products.mixExceedsBudget: This mix exceeds this hamper budget

details.title: 3. Make it personal
details.body: Delivery date जरूरी है ताकि हम पहले ही feasibility confirm कर सकें.

message: जो message card पर लिखना है

summary.note: Final mix stock, size और presentation के आधार पर balance किया जा सकता है. Major substitution से पहले confirmation लिया जाएगा.

payment.title: 4. Prepaid payment
payment.body: Payment केवल bank/UPI credit verify होने के बाद Paid माना जाएगा.
payment.setupPending: Business UPI ID launch से पहले connect होना बाकी है.
payment.successBody: Payment verification के बाद order processing शुरू होगी.

promise.title: Trust, built into every step.
promise.body: Payment से dispatch तक customer को साफ process, proof और communication मिलेगा.

cta.title: More than gifts. Happier moments.
cta.body: Thoughtful. Meaningful. Always special. That is the standard every Celebration hamper should feel like.

tracking.title: Track your Celebration
tracking.invalid: This tracking link is invalid or expired.
tracking.lookupBody: Order ID aur order ke phone number ke last digits se secure tracking kholen.
tracking.lookupValidation: Order ID aur phone ke required last digits enter karein.
tracking.lookupFailed: Order details match nahi hui. Order ID aur phone digits dobara check karein.
tracking.lookupPrivacy: Security ke liye full phone number yahan show ya store nahi kiya jata.
tracking.approvalTitle: Packing video dekhkar dispatch approve karein
tracking.approvalBody: Video ko dhyan se check karein. Approval ke baad order courier handover ke liye ready maana jayega.
tracking.approvalConsent: Maine packing video dekh liya hai aur isi packing ke saath dispatch approve karta/karti hoon.
tracking.approvalNote: Approval ke baad admin ko shipping/tracking details add karne ka next step milega.
tracking.approvalWaitingTitle: Packing approval abhi pending nahi hai
tracking.approvalWaitingBody: Packing video upload hone ke baad yahin approval button active hoga.
tracking.approvalUnavailableBody: Order ko packing-video-ready stage par aane dein. Uske baad yahin se approval diya ja sakega.
tracking.approvedBody: Aapka approval record ho gaya hai. Ab order shipping ke liye ready hai.

admin.videoTooLarge: Packing video allowed size limit से बड़ी है.
admin.videoTypeInvalid: Selected video format allowed नहीं है.
admin.shippingNotAvailable: Shipping details customer approval के बाद available होंगी.
admin.operationsSubtitle: Payment, packing, approval और shipping को एक ही जगह manage करें.
admin.searchPlaceholder: Order ID, customer, phone, UTR, pincode या tracking खोजें
admin.noMatchingOrders: इस search/filter में कोई order नहीं मिला.
